purpose: Single authoritative inventory of every cryptographic format in the repository and its lifecycle state. Every key-derivation and cipher format must appear here. A format that reaches production without an entry is a CI failure (scripts/security/crypto-format-audit.mjs), because unregistered legacy crypto is how under-provisioned KDFs become permanent.

lifecycle.ACTIVE: Current format. New ciphertext must be written in this format.
lifecycle.LEGACY_READ: Frozen derivation kept solely to decrypt existing ciphertext. MUST NOT be used for new writes. Requires retireAfter + migrationTrigger.
lifecycle.RETIRED: Migration complete; the read path has been deleted. Entry kept as a tombstone so the format is never silently reintroduced.

formats.purpose: Purpose-bound subkey derivation for every high-entropy secret in the app
formats.notes: Contexts are frozen once shipped. Add a NEW context and a NEW ciphertext version rather than editing an existing one.

formats.purpose: Sensitive field encryption at rest (AWS KMS envelope encryption)
Local master-key mode DEK derivation for backup archives (dev/test only; production uses KMS envelope)

params.salt: 16 random bytes per archive, recorded in header.kdf.salt

formats.notes: Per-archive salt and pinned cost. Two archives of the same database under one master key must derive different DEKs.

formats.purpose: Auth profile vault records written before per-record salts were pinned
formats.migrationTrigger: rekey-on-read in getAuthProfileSnapshotByEmail: any record whose ciphertext format is not 'v2' is rewritten in v2 format on successful decrypt (staleFormat check).
formats.notes: Retires automatically as records are read. N=2^14 is 128x below the current work factor.

formats.purpose: Auth profile vault records written before per-record salts existed at all
formats.migrationTrigger: rekey-on-read in getAuthProfileSnapshotByEmail: the 3-part format reports formatVersion 'legacy', which fails the staleFormat check and is rewritten as v2 on read.
formats.notes: Fixed salt means every deployment sharing AUTH_VAULT_SECRET derived one identical key.

formats.purpose: Trusted-device challenge tokens sealed before the HKDF migration
formats.migrationTrigger: decryptPayload tries HKDF first and falls back to this derivation. Tokens are single-use and short-TTL, so this path becomes unreachable once no sealed challenge outlives one deploy cycle.
formats.notes: Delete deriveLegacyTokenKey once the maximum challenge TTL has elapsed with no fallback hits.

formats.purpose: Backup archives encrypted before the per-archive salt was added
formats.migrationTrigger: commandDecrypt falls back to the frozen derivation only when header.kdf.salt is absent. Retire by re-encrypting retained archives, or when the backup retention window guarantees no v1 archive can still be restored.
formats.notes: Bound by backup retention, not by deploys — a v1 archive may sit in S3 for its full retention period.

formats.purpose: Local-master-key field encryption records written before the HKDF migration
formats.migrationTrigger: Unreachable in production: assertEnablementContract throws when FIELD_ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY is set while NODE_ENV=production. Retire by deleting normalizeLegacyKeyMaterial once no non-production deployment holds v1 local ciphertext.
formats.notes: Production-gated dead path. Kept only so local/dev v1 ciphertext still decrypts.

formats.purpose: OTP flow tokens issued before the HKDF migration
formats.kdf: single-round SHA-256 (no extract step, no salt, no work factor)
formats.migrationTrigger: decryptPayload tries HKDF first and falls back to this derivation. Tokens live 5 minutes, so this is already unreachable for any token issued after the migration deployed. Delete once one TTL has elapsed in every environment.
formats.notes: The version tag OTP_FLOW_TOKEN_VERSION is still 'v1' but is a label, not a key selector; new tokens are encrypted with HKDF via deriveEncryptionKey.

formats.purpose: Recovery code hashes stored before the HKDF domain separation was added
formats.kdf: HMAC-SHA256 keyed directly by the secret, with no HKDF domain separation
formats.migrationTrigger: recoveryCodeHashCandidates verifies against both forms, newest first. Retire by rewriting stored hashes to the v2 form on successful verification, or when no un-migrated recovery codes remain.
formats.notes: Lacks domain separation, so the same secret+code pair is indistinguishable across purposes that reuse the secret.

formats.purpose: TOTP secrets encrypted before the HKDF domain separation was added
formats.migrationTrigger: reencryptTotpSecretIfNeeded in server/services/totpMfaService.js upgrades a v1 secret to the HKDF derivation on successful verification.
formats.notes: Dictionary-attackable against a captured v1 ciphertext if MFA_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY is operator-chosen rather than generated.

formats.purpose: Phone/email blind indexes under the original contexts
formats.notes: Migration documented COMPLETE through step 4. Verified: every request-path caller imports only the *V2 variants. The v1 compute functions survive only in server/scripts/backfill-blind-indexes.js (migration verification), server/scripts/backfill-field-encryption.js (backfill), and tests. Tombstone: do not reintroduce into a request path.
